credits.title: Vrushakarma
credits.overview: In a desperate quest to decode ancient cave carvings, a treasure hunter hungry for untold riches, an obsessed archaeologist, and a devoted history student race against time to unravel a prophecy tied to royal lineage and the impending apocalypse, confronting the forces of destiny and evil along the way.

credits.title: Virupaksha
credits.overview: Set in a village named Rudravanam in 1990's, Surya along with his mother, visit there after a long time. Suddenly a series of mysterious deaths occur due to an unknown person's occult practice and whole village is scared. Will Surya find the person causing the deaths and save the village?

credits.title: Bham Bolenath
credits.overview: Three different stories culminate into series of coincidences which create comedy of confusion.
